items.where: the intro screen, under DUMMIES, before the mode select: the one line that tells a new player what to do, in both modes. Quirky but obvious. Facts: you are a crash-test dummy; you want the cars to hit you; the cars avoid you; combos score more; upgrades come with progress
items.text: You are a crash-test dummy. Cars avoid you: get hit anyway, combos count more, and upgrades follow.

items.where: Arcade's level card, the goal line under the district's line, in bold after '>>>': what to do in an Arcade shift. Facts: write off bodies; every {Q} write-offs the grade rises (tougher chassis, denser traffic); the run ends when the shift's vehicles run out; the score is the points. {Q} is the district's quota, a placeholder the game fills
items.text: Write off bodies; every {Q} write-offs, the grade rises. Earn points until the vehicles run out.
